name: NecroMorfosis
source:
Filia is a magic student, specifically studying a magic known as Death Astrology. However, to graduate from the subject she loves so much, she needs to successfully revive a corpse and thus pass the Necromancy course. Unfortunately, she's not exactly good at it.

[From [url=https://mackarknest.itch.io/necromorfosis]itch.io[/url]]
